auth.subtitle: Sign in to open the counter
auth.signOutConfirmBody: You will need your password to get back in.
auth.forgotPasswordBody: Only the shop owner can reset it. Ask them to set a new one for you.

errors.accountLocked: Account locked after too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, or ask the shop owner to reset your password.
errors.accountInactive: This account is no longer active. Contact the shop owner.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.networkBody: Check that the shop server is running and that the address in Server settings is right.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer.
errors.timeoutBody: It may be busy. Pull down to try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.
errors.forbidden: This is limited to the shop owner.
errors.forbiddenBody: Ask the shop owner if you need these figures.
errors.notFound: This server does not have that yet.
errors.notFoundBody: The shop server is likely running an older version than this app. Restart it after updating, then pull down to retry.
errors.conflictBody: Someone may have changed the same record. Pull down to refresh and try again.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.unknown: Something did not work. Try again.
errors.cameraPermission: Allow camera access in your phone's settings to take a photo.
errors.mediaLibraryPermission: Allow photo access in your phone's settings to choose an image.
errors.imageTooLarge: That photo is too large. Try a lower camera resolution or a different photo (max 5MB).
errors.creditLimitBody: This customer cannot take more on khata right now.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Shop owner only
reports.footnote: Every report reads the same figures the bills were written with. Cancelled and draft bills are never counted.
reports.salesBody: Day by day and bill by bill, for any period
reports.productSalesBody: Quantity and value sold per product
reports.gstSummaryBody: CGST, SGST and IGST by rate, for filing
reports.stockValuationBody: What the stock on the shelf is worth
reports.lowStockBody: Products at or below their reorder level
reports.ageingBody: How long that money has been owed
reports.paymentCollectionBody: What came in, by cash, UPI or bank
reports.profitMarginBody: Revenue against cost, overall and per product
reports.dateHint: Use YYYY-MM-DD. Both dates are included.
reports.invalidDate: Use the format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-08-01.
reports.rangeBackwards: The start date is after the end date.
reports.truncatedNote: Showing the {{count}} most recent bills. The summaries above cover the whole period.
reports.estimatesExcluded: {{value}} of estimate sales is excluded — an estimate is not a tax invoice.
reports.emptyGst: No tax invoices in this period.
reports.valuationNote: Meters and pieces are counted separately — a combined quantity would mean nothing.
reports.lowStockCapped: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}}. Export for the full list.
reports.emptyAgeing: Nothing is outstanding against a bill.
reports.unbucketedNote: {{value}} of the {{total}} total is an opening balance not tied to a bill, so it cannot be aged.
reports.emptyCollection: Nothing was collected in this period.
reports.receiptsPending: No standalone khata receipts. Recording them arrives with the payments module.
reports.profitNote: Revenue excludes GST — tax collected is owed to the government, not shop income.

bills.ownOnlyNote: You see your own bills only.

bills.editGstWarning: This is a GST tax invoice
bills.editGstWarningBody: For a filed period, a credit note against the original is the safer correction. Editing is recorded either way.
bills.editReasonHint: Required. This is what the shop owner sees in the edit log.
bills.editNeedsALine: A bill needs at least one line. Add a product or cancel the bill instead.
bills.editCreditNeedsCustomer: This bill has no customer, so it cannot go on a khata.
bills.belowPaidBody: ₹{{paid}} has already been received against this bill. Raise a credit note for the difference instead of editing it down.
bills.discardEditBody: The bill will stay as it is.
bills.revisedTitle_one: This bill has been edited once

bills.revisedBody: Last edited {{date}}. The customer may be holding an earlier printout.
bills.revisionsOwnOnly: You see your own edits only.
bills.revisionsEmptyBody: This bill is exactly as it was written.
bills.editLogEmptyBody: Every edit, who made it and why, will appear here.
bills.emptyInRangeBody: Pick another day, or tap Custom for a longer stretch.

customers.checkingPhone: Checking if this number is already on file…
customers.wholesaleHint: Billed at wholesale rates on every bill.
customers.stateHint: Gujarat gets CGST+SGST; anywhere else gets IGST.

khata.errorAmountPositive: The amount must be more than zero.

khata.reasonRequired: A reason is required for every note.

staff.title: Staff accounts
staff.subtitle: Who can sign in, and what they see
staff.emptyBody: Add an account for anyone who works the counter. You choose which screens they see and what they may do.
staff.noMatchBody: Try part of the name or the username instead.
staff.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dot, underscore and hyphen. This is what they type to sign in.
staff.usernameLockedHint: A username cannot be changed — it is how this account reads in the record of who did what.
staff.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number. Tell it to them in person.
staff.passwordOnDetail: To change the password, use Reset password on the account screen. It signs them out everywhere.
staff.roleStaffHint: Counter work. Reports, cost price, stock valuation and what the whole shop is owed stay out of reach.
staff.roleAdminHint: Full access to everything, including this screen. Give it only to someone who runs the shop.
staff.maxDiscountHint: The most this person may take off a bill. A bill over the limit is refused by the server, not just hidden.
staff.languageHint: What they see when they sign in. They can change it themselves afterwards.
staff.menuIntro: Tick the screens this person needs. This tidies their app down to their job — it does not decide what they are allowed to do.
staff.menuIntroDetail: What this account sees when it signs in.
staff.menuIntroAdmin: A shop owner sees every screen. There is nothing to choose here.
staff.neverAssignableBody: These stay with the shop owner whatever is ticked above. The server refuses them for a staff account even if the request is made by hand.
staff.permissionIntro: These are checked by the server on every action, not just hidden in the app.
staff.permissionIntroAdmin: A shop owner holds every permission.
staff.resetWarning: Setting a new password signs them out of every device straight away.
staff.resetConfirmBody: They will be signed out immediately, on every device, and will need the new password to get back in.
staff.resetToast: New password set for {{name}}. They have been signed out.
staff.deactivateConfirmBody: They are signed out immediately, wherever they are, and cannot sign in again until you switch the account back on. Their bills and history stay exactly as they are.
staff.deactivatedSignedOutToast: {{name}} has been signed out and can no longer sign in.
staff.activateConfirmBody: They will be able to sign in again with their existing password. Any lockout is cleared.
staff.cannotDeactivateSelf: You cannot switch off the account you are signed in with.
staff.inactiveBannerBody: They cannot sign in. Switch it back on below when they return.
staff.lockedBanner: Locked after too many wrong passwords
staff.lockedBannerBody: Clear the lockout to let them try again, or reset the password if they have forgotten it.
staff.errorUsername: At least 3 characters — letters, numbers, dot, underscore or hyphen.
staff.errorPassword: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
staff.errorDiscount: A discount limit is between 0 and 100.
staff.errorNoMenus: Pick at least one screen, or they will have nowhere to go.
staff.errorKhataNeedsCustomers: Khata opens from a customer, so Customers has to be ticked as well.
